content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue uploading my PLC program from an SD card to my [product_name] device ([article_no] ([version_no])). When saving the program to the SD card and inserting it into the device, it doesn't recognize the program file. Uploading via Ethernet works fine. I noticed that the device writes a ".bin" file to the SD card, but [product_name] programming software does not allow me to save files in ".bin" format directly. Has anyone found a solution for this?
The .bin file must have a specific name: LOGO_U_P.bin. Other file names will not work. Use File > Save as > and select your SD card path.
So, I need to save the program on the SD card as LOGO_U_P.bin for it to be recognized by the device? The software only allows saving files with these extensions: .lld .lgo .pdf .jpg .dmp.

Correct. Insert the SD card into your PC and save your program using the method described. Alternatively, you can transfer the program to the device and then copy it to the SD card using the device's menu. May I ask why you prefer saving the program to the SD card?
Hi, You can refer to the [document] for details. See chapter 9 for more information about the memory card. (Writing to SD card is possible when inserted in the device.) Best regards, [user_name]
This is for a client whose PLC will operate in a hazardous (EX/explosive) zone. Changes to the program cannot be made while powered on to minimize explosion risk when the cabinet is open.
Thank you for clarifying. Then saving the program as a .bin file via PC to the SD card is the correct approach.
I discovered that I had to convert my ladder program to function blocks in order to save it with the .bin file extension.
I don't use ladder logic; I work exclusively with function block diagrams. This is one more reason I avoid ladder.
How did you resolve your issue? What did you do to save the file as a .bin format?

Welcome to the forum, [user_name]. To save a function block diagram as a .bin file: Go to File > Save as and choose your preferred storage location. Select "Binary dump (*.bin)" as the file type. The software will automatically assign the correct file name LOGO_U_P for the .bin file; other names will not be accepted.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face challenges transferring program files from SD cards to [product_name] devices, mainly due to specific file format and naming requirements. The programming software doesn't provide a straightforward option to save in the required .bin format, particularly for ladder logic programs, resulting in confusion and workflow interruptions. This is especially problematic in environments requiring strict safety protocols.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an uncomplicated way to save and transfer programs to [product_name] via SD card, regardless of the programming language used. They need this to streamline updates while adhering to safety restrictions in critical environments.
